what_happened: The job to remove records/ from main and empty the [history] exempt list failed in planning (round 1 of 5), before any code was written. The reading said the job touches no code and kept crates/ out of scope. The critic found this wrong. The per-commit gate refuses any deleted file under records/ (content.rs:46-61, run on every Athena commit). Admission refuses any job change under records/ (admission.rs:695). Several gate tests depend on a non-empty exempt list. With code out of scope, criteria 1, 5 and 6 could not be met. The critic raised one blocker (no mechanism can delete records/), two majors (the plan expects required suites to go red and still sends the producer; the dependents list omits readers that refuse the deletion) and one minor (the producer cannot check the Step 1 preconditions). The critic said the fix is a prerequisite code job that allows a post-cutover removal and moves the legacy commit ids into test helpers.
cause: The reading was accepted without being checked against the code that enforces the append-only and admission rules on records/. A request phrased as config and file deletion looked like a no-code job. Nothing resolved which gates, admission rules and tests touch the files and settings the request names. The reading's "no code" scope was an assumption, not a traced fact, so the contradiction surfaced only when the critic read the code.
prevention: Before a reading is accepted, run a step that, for each file or setting the request would delete or change, lists the gate checks, admission rules and tests that read it. If any of them refuse or depend on the change, the reading must either include the code change or split into a prerequisite code job followed by the config and deletion job. A reading that forbids code must not be accepted when such a refusal exists.
proposed_request: Remove the legacy records/ tree from main and empty the [history] exempt list, as two ordered jobs. Job 1 (code): change the per-commit gate (content.rs append-only check) and admission (admission.rs) so a post-cutover removal of records/ is allowed. Move the seven legacy commit ids that the gate tests need into test-only helpers so those tests no longer depend on a non-empty exempt list. Update every reader that refuses the deletion. Acceptance: the full test suites pass with exempt empty, and a commit deleting files under records/ after the cutover passes the gate and admission. Job 2 (depends on Job 1 by job id): delete records/ from main, empty [history] exempt in athena.toml, add the next decision entry (D171) and a CHANGELOG.md entry. Acceptance: records/ is absent on main, exempt is empty, and the full history check and all required suites pass.
